extracted.intended_audience: individuals (attorneys/agents/registrants) seeking reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; USPTO enrollment & discipline stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation of a petition for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58, based on a filed petition, supporting affidavit, and review of the record to determine eligibility. The Office of Enrollment and Discipline/Director issues the decision to grant or deny reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement (37 C.F.R. § 11.58)
rubrics_metrics.description: A petition for reinstatement must be filed and may be supported by an affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58; the petition and supporting affidavit are the initiating documents for reinstatement consideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As stated: 'Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Eric B. Alspaugh (Registration Number 54,783) received on December 21, 2021. Mr. Alspaugh also filed an affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the petition.' Filing the petition and the § 11.58 affidavit is the procedural prerequisite for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's eligibility determination for reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Reinstatement is decided by the Director (Office of Enrollment and Discipline) after careful review of the petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to the applicant's eligibility for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As described: 'After careful review of the petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.' The Director issues the final decision (grant or denial); here the petition was granted.
